means: host test: a failing driver init logs an error
requirement: The system shall log an error message if a sensor fails its initialisation

means: host tests: filter defaults when the configuration read fails

means: host tests: one failed sensor, the others keep running

means: console shows six channels updating at the configured interval

means: host test: a read failure logs the error code
requirement: The system shall log the error code if a sensor read operation fails

means: host tests: last validated value and the filter state are held

means: timestamp present in the snapshot, the register map and the telemetry payload

means: a periodic and a remote-read value pass the same filter

means: host tests: clamping to the range boundary
requirement: The system shall clamp out-of-range readings to the nearest range boundary

means: host tests: first-order IIR, alpha 0.1, step response

means: the register map value equals the value on the LCD
requirement: The system shall make processed sensor data available for Modbus register access and LCD display

means: host tests: a failed read marks the reading invalid

means: control `read` over MQTT triggers an extra read and a result
requirement: The system shall perform an additional sensor read upon receiving a remote read request

means: host tests: rolling history of validated readings per channel

means: host tests: window of 5 minutes
requirement: The history shall span a window of 5 minutes

means: host tests: fixed 5 s sampling independent of the polling rate
requirement: The history shall be sampled at a fixed interval of 5 seconds, independent of the configured polling rate

means: host tests: 60 entries per channel
requirement: The history shall retain 60 entries per channel

means: host tests: value, validity flag and timestamp per entry
requirement: Each history entry shall include the measurement value, its validity flag, and its acquisition timestamp

means: host tests and inspection: RAM only, cleared by reset

means: host tests: a stale reading is recorded invalid

means: set a threshold below the value: the alarm is raised

means: restore the threshold: the alarm clears
requirement: The system shall clear existing alarm if the current measurement is within the configured alarm thresholds

means: host tests: hysteresis on clear
requirement: The system shall apply configurable hysteresis when clearing alarms to prevent flapping. The hysteresis value is expressed in the same engineering unit and scale as the corresponding alarm threshold (as encoded in `modbus-register-map.md` §6.4). Default: 0 (disabled). Configurable range: 0 to the absolute difference between the configured HIGH and LOW threshold values for that channel.

means: the header clock equals the reading time (framebuffer)

means: host tests: several slave addresses

means: a profile needs its mandatory fields
requirement: The system shall require each device profile to specify:

requirement: The system shall verify the device identifier returned by a Modbus slave against the profile bound to its address during link establishment, and shall reject mismatches

means: a profile mismatch is logged with identifier and address
requirement: The system shall log device-profile validation failures, including the offending device identifier and the slave address

means: a malformed remote command is rejected and logged

means: telemetry on the broker at the configured period

means: health payload fields
requirement: The system shall publish to the cloud the most recent device health metrics: stack high watermarks, free TLS arena (the only dynamic memory, REQ-NF-408), CPU load, WiFi RSSI, reconnection count, MQTT failure count, Modbus CRC/timeout/success counts, uptime, MCU temperature, buffer occupancy

means: the alarm notification is published
requirement: The system shall publish to the cloud the alarm notification

means: change the telemetry interval by console and by cloud command
requirement: The system shall publish sensor telemetry at a configurable interval, adjustable locally via the serial console and remotely via cloud command.

means: change the health interval by console and by cloud command
requirement: The system shall publish device health data at a configurable interval, adjustable locally via the serial console and remotely via cloud command.

means: TLS 1.2 with a client certificate is accepted by the broker
requirement: The system shall connect to AWS IoT Core using MQTT over TLS with X.509 certificate authentication

means: stop the broker, restart it, the device reconnects
requirement: The system shall reconnect automatically if the MQTT connection is lost

means: every payload parses as JSON

means: every payload has a schema version
requirement: The system shall include a schema version identifier in all MQTT payloads.

means: telemetry, alarms and health use separate topics
requirement: The system shall use separate MQTT topics for telemetry, alarms, and device health data

means: the serial number is in every payload
requirement: The system shall include the device serial number

means: telemetry of an invalid channel carries the error flag

requirement: The system shall publish sensor data marked as invalid to the cloud with an error flag. *(Relocated from §2.1 Sensor Acquisition — this is a cloud publication responsibility.)*

means: the time updates at boot and periodically
requirement: The system shall update the internal time during the boot and periodically every 3600 seconds thereafter (default; configurable, see REQ-NF-210). Basis: TIME_SERVICE_NTP_INTERVAL_S_DEFAULT; a 32.768 kHz crystal at ±20 ppm drifts about 72 ms per hour, so the default keeps the RTC well inside one second. The drift itself has not been measured on the boards.

means: NTP synchronisation from the configured server list
requirement: The system shall synchronise time using NTP, with a configurable list of NTP servers

means: the RTC keeps the time across a reset
requirement: The system shall update the RTC with the synchronised time

means: the Field Device clock receives the time on connection
requirement: The system shall write the current time to the field device via Modbus holding register on initial connection and at regular intervals.

means: without NTP the data is flagged unsynchronised
requirement: The system shall use uptime-based timestamps and flag data as "unsynchronised" if NTP synchronisation has not been completed.

means: restore the network: the time update is retried
requirement: The system shall retry to get the time update as soon as the internet connection is restored.

means: unplug and replug RS-485: the time is written again
requirement: The system shall retry writing the synchronised time to the field device via Modbus as soon as Modbus connectivity to the field device is restored. (Covers UC-13 exception E2 — field-node disconnected during time-write step.)

means: a parameter change by cloud command is accepted
requirement: The system shall accept operational parameter changes from the Remote Operator via cloud command

means: an invalid parameter change is refused
requirement: The system shall validate remote parameter changes before applying them.

means: a confirmation or rejection is sent to the cloud
requirement: The system shall send a confirmation or rejection response to the cloud after processing a remote parameter change.

means: the remote restart command restarts the device
requirement: The system shall execute remote restart command

means: no confirmation: the restart is cancelled
requirement: The system shall request confirmation from the Remote Operator before executing a restart and shall cancel the restart if no confirmation arrives within 30 seconds

means: a declined confirmation cancels the restart
requirement: The system shall cancel the restart if the Remote Operator declines confirmation

means: restart success is reported after the self-check
requirement: The system shall report restart success after reboot and self-check

means: the self-check verifies sensors and links
requirement: The system shall complete a self-check after restart, verifying sensor initialisations and communication links

means: the firmware downloads over MQTT/TLS
requirement: The system shall download the firmware image from the authenticated cloud source via the existing MQTT/TLS channel.

means: a download resumes at the interruption point
requirement: The system shall resume a firmware download from the point of interruption if the connection is restored.

means: 3 consecutive failures discard the partial image
requirement: The system shall discard the partially downloaded firmware image if the download fails after 3 consecutive retries.

means: a download failure logs an error
requirement: The system shall log an error if the firmware image download fails

means: a second update command is refused while one runs
requirement: The system shall reject a new update command if one is in progress

means: the update result is reported
requirement: The system shall report the update result to the cloud

means: an update command from a wrong source is refused
requirement: The system shall only accept firmware update commands from an authenticated source

means: a bad size, format or header is rejected
requirement: The system shall validate the firmware image (size, format, and header integrity, excluding cryptographic verification — see REQ-DM-080).

means: a failed validation restores the current firmware
requirement: The system shall discard the firmware update process and restore the current firmware if the firmware validation fails

means: a failed validation logs an error
requirement: The system shall log an error if the firmware image validation fails

means: the inactive bank becomes the boot bank
requirement: The system shall set the newly written firmware partition (inactive bank) as the active boot partition.

means: the new firmware runs a self-check
requirement: The system shall trigger a self-check validation on the new firmware

means: a failed self-check rolls back
requirement: The system shall rollback the previous firmware image if the self-check fails

means: the current image is kept until the self-check passes
requirement: The system shall retain the current firmware image until the success of the self-check validation

means: dual-bank partitions per the layout document
requirement: The system shall maintain a dual-bank partition scheme to enable firmware rollback

means: a wrong signature is refused
requirement: The system shall verify the cryptographic signature of the firmware image before applying the update

means: every change survives a reset
requirement: The system shall persist all configuration changes to non-volatile storage

means: a profile update by console and by remote configuration
requirement: The system shall accept device-profile updates via the provisioning mechanism (UC-16) and via remote configuration (UC-15)

means: a changed profile re-probes the slave
requirement: The system shall trigger re-probing of an affected slave when its device profile is added or updated at runtime

means: cut the network: messages are buffered in flash
requirement: The system shall buffer all outbound cloud messages (telemetry, alarms, device health) in non-volatile storage when internet connectivity is lost

means: restore the network: delivered in order
requirement: The system shall publish buffered messages in chronological order when connectivity is restored

means: more than 254 buffered entries: the oldest are dropped
requirement: The system shall discard the oldest buffered messages when the buffer reaches its maximum capacity of 254 entries (SAF_CAPACITY: one entry per 4 KB sector of the CircularFlashLog data ring, worst case)

means: worst polling cycle measured against 100 ms
requirement: The system shall complete a full sensor polling cycle (read all sensors, timestamp, queue data) within 100 ms

means: alarm detected within one cycle
requirement: The system shall detect an alarm condition within one polling cycle of the threshold being exceeded

means: alarm cleared within one cycle
requirement: The system shall clear an alarm condition within one polling cycle of the measurement being in the range

means: 3 failed transactions declare the link failed
requirement: The system shall declare Modbus communication link failure after 3 consecutive failed transactions, where each failed transaction comprises 1 initial request plus up to 3 retries (REQ-MB-060) with no valid response received within the 200 ms per-attempt timeout (REQ-MB-050). See REQ-MB-060.

means: 3 good responses declare it restored
requirement: The system shall declare Modbus communication restored after 3 consecutive successful responses

means: 200 ms response timeout measured with the probe
requirement: The system shall consider a Modbus request failed if no response is received within 200 ms of transmission.

means: a message is queued within 200 ms of the data
requirement: The system shall queue an MQTT message for publication within 200 ms of data being ready

means: a remote command starts within 500 ms
requirement: The system shall begin executing a received remote command within 500 ms of receipt

means: LCD refresh rate measured
expectation: RK: UI task runs every 40 ms, the value refresh every 200 ms
requirement: The system shall use a refresh rate of 5Hz for the field node LCD

means: hang the sensor task: watchdog reset after 10 s
requirement: The system shall use a system watchdog of 10 seconds.

means: default polling frames at 1 Hz on the line
requirement: The system shall poll the field node at default polling rate of 1Hz

means: telemetry period 60 s
requirement: The system shall publish the sensor measurements to AWS IoT Core each 60 seconds (default; see REQ-CC-030).

means: health period 5 min
requirement: The system shall publish the health data to AWS IoT Core each 5 minutes (default; see REQ-CC-040). Source: vision §5.8.

means: alarm latency at most 500 ms (the Raspberry Pi bench)
requirement: The system shall publish the alarm notification to AWS IoT Core within 500 ms since their detection

means: 100 ms and 10 s accepted, outside refused
requirement: The system shall use a polling rate within the range 0.1 Hz (minimum, 10 s period) and 10 Hz (maximum, 100 ms period). (Lower bound: minimum meaningful environmental sampling interval; upper bound: REQ-NF-100 sensor-cycle budget.)

means: network off: sensors and alarms keep running
requirement: The system shall continue local sensor acquisition and alarm evaluation when internet connectivity is lost

means: a short bus interruption recovers without a restart
requirement: The system shall recover Modbus communication automatically after a transient bus error without requiring a restart

means: watchdog reset: Operational within 5 s
requirement: The system shall restart and resume normal operation within 5 seconds after a watchdog reset. See REQ-NF-203.

means: normal reset: Operational within 5 s
requirement: The system shall restart and resume normal operation within 5 seconds after a normal reset. See REQ-NF-202.

means: a failed update rolls back within 10 s
requirement: The system shall roll back to the previous firmware and resume normal operation within 10 seconds if a firmware update fails post-installation

means: host tests: a failed sensor is reinitialised

means: telemetry is published with QoS 0
requirement: The system shall use MQTT QoS 0 for publishing sensor telemetry

means: alarms are published with QoS 1
requirement: The system shall use MQTT QoS 1 for publishing alarm notifications

means: host tests: the error indicator value
requirement: The system shall substitute a defined error indicator value for any sensor that fails to provide a reading

means: reconnect after 2 s, doubling to 60 s
requirement: The system shall start reconnecting within 2 seconds of detecting a connection loss on the WiFi layer or the MQTT layer, shall double the interval between consecutive failed attempts up to a maximum of 60 seconds, shall retry indefinitely, and shall return to the 2 second start interval after a successful connection.

means: RTC resync period, configurable from the console
requirement: The system shall synchronise the RTC every 3600 seconds by default; the interval shall be configurable from the console (`ntp-interval-min`). See REQ-TS-000.

means: the Field Device time is written after each NTP sync
requirement: The system shall write the time to the field node after every successful NTP synchronisation (3600 seconds by default, REQ-NF-210) and whenever the Modbus link to the field node comes up.

means: covered by TS-040
requirement: See REQ-TS-040. *(Requirement text retained in REQ-TS-040 as the authoritative functional-section entry; this entry retained for ID continuity.)*

means: power-on to Operational within 10 s

means: power cut during a flash write: the device recovers

means: 3 missed polls: the node is reported offline

means: health is published with QoS 0
requirement: The system shall use MQTT QoS 0 for publishing device health data

means: TLS 1.2 or higher on the wire
requirement: The system shall encrypt all communication with AWS IoT Core using TLS 1.2 or higher

means: the client certificate is required and checked
requirement: The system shall authenticate to AWS IoT Core using X.509 client certificates

means: inspect storage: no plaintext passphrase or private key
requirement: The system shall not store provisioning credentials (WiFi passphrase and X.509 private key) in plaintext.

means: no network console in the code, UART only
requirement: The system shall restrict CLI access to physical serial connections only

means: an image with a wrong signature is refused
requirement: The system shall cryptographically verify firmware images before installation

means: a plain-TCP broker is refused

means: Tier 1 parameters are refused over the cloud
requirement: The system shall restrict Tier 1 configuration parameters to local serial access only

means: linker output: flash within 1 MB

means: QSPI map: all regions within 8 MB

means: linker output: RAM within 320 KB

means: linker output: flash within 2 MB
requirement: The system shall operate within the 2 MB FLASH of the STM32F469 Discovery

means: QSPI map: all regions within 16 MB
requirement: The system shall operate within the 16 MB QUAD-SPI FLASH of the STM32F469 Discovery

means: buffer partition size at most 4 MB
requirement: The system shall allocate no more than 4 MB of non-volatile storage for buffered outbound sensor measurements on the gateway (StoreAndForward / CircularFlashLog). The field device has no store-and-forward buffer (see vision §5.9).

means: no malloc or free call reachable in the image (symbol check)
requirement: The system shall not use dynamic memory allocation (malloc/free) after initialisation completes

means: log lines carry level, time and module
requirement: The system shall log diagnostic events with severity level, timestamp, and source module identifier

means: the HAL check script and the include rule
requirement: The system shall enforce a layered architecture where no module above the driver layer imports vendor-specific headers

means: clang-format and cppcheck in CI plus a BARR-C review
expectation: RK: no full review done yet
requirement: The system shall be implemented in conformance with the project's BARR-C:2018 subset coding standard.

means: the version via the console and in the health message
requirement: The system shall report its firmware version via the CLI and in cloud health messages

means: trace output on the debug channel
requirement: The system shall provide a diagnostic output channel for runtime tracing and debugging

means: run Doxygen, read the warnings
requirement: The system shall include Doxygen-compatible documentation comments for all public API functions

means: review of the interfaces plus the HAL check
requirement: The system shall expose vendor-neutral interfaces to the middleware and application layers

means: fault injection: the cause is reported at the next start
requirement: On a processor fault, a failed assertion or a task stack overflow the system shall record the cause and the processor state in memory that survives a reset, write a report on the diagnostic output, and restart; the next start shall report the recorded cause once. Restart time is bound by REQ-NF-203.
